name: WebAuthn Passkey Authentication
description: Biometric authentication (Face ID, fingerprint, security keys) and QR-code device pairing via WebAuthn/passkeys

passkeysPath.description: Path to passkeys.json persistence file. Defaults to {stateDir}/webauthn/passkeys.json

deviceApprovalToken.description: Token granted to approved devices (e.g. an MCP bearer token)

hmacSecret.description: Secret used for HMAC signing of QR approval URLs. Falls back to gateway token if not set.

rpId.label: Relying Party ID
rpId.help: The domain name for WebAuthn (must match the site's actual domain)

rpName.label: Relying Party Name
rpName.help: Displayed to the user during passkey registration

origin.label: Origin URL
origin.help: Full origin URL including scheme (e.g. https://example.com)

hmacSecret.label: HMAC Secret
hmacSecret.help: Used to sign QR code approval URLs

deviceApprovalToken.label: Device Approval Token
deviceApprovalToken.help: Token granted to devices after biometric approval
